[EXCLUSIVE:store white labeling]
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:ADMIN]

[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/white-labeling/store/{{store_id}} - [CAPTURE] the whole record as BEFORE
[NAV] open {{FRONT_URL}} in a fresh guest context
[WAIT] the home page renders
[ASSERT] note the computed --color-primary-500 on :root as BEFORE_PRIMARY and <html data-preset> as BEFORE_PRESET
[ASSERT] BEFORE.themePresetName lower-cased with spaces replaced by "-" differs from {{preset}} normalised the same way (otherwise BLOCKED:CONDITION_NOT_MET: the save would change nothing and the guest page could not show it)
[GRID] click 'Stores' in the main menu, then click the row '{{STORE_ID}}'
[ACT] click the widget 'White labeling'
[WAIT] the 'White labeling' blade shows the record

[WAIT] the save notification appears
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/white-labeling/store/{{store_id}} - [CAPTURE] the whole record as AFTER
[NAV] open {{FRONT_URL}} in a fresh guest context
[WAIT] the home page renders
[ASSERT] note the computed --color-primary-500 on :root as AFTER_PRIMARY and <html data-preset> as AFTER_PRESET

[FORM] the 'Theme preset name' select shows {{preset}} after the save
